tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so:1$0000250 thugs dam zab mo'o:1$0000300

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam gsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: rgyal ba mi 'gyur chos dbyings 'od kyi sku: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang chen gsung gi bdag: gar gyi bdag nyid khrag 'thung rol pa'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi las byang 'dir bshad bya: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: dang po sngon 'gro'i las rim chos lnga ste: mtshams gcod byin rlabs dam bca' bzung: ye shes byin dbab bshags pa bya: dngos gzhi las khrigs nyi shu ste: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gzhal yas bskyed: lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang mchod kho na nyid: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol mchod: glu bro bstod pa dzap bzlas so: rjes kyi las khrigs lnga yin te: tshogs dang lhag ma las la bskul: brtan ma rta bro las rjes bsdu: de ltar las gzhung rtsa thor bsdebs: skal pa can gyis spyod par shog: sa ma ya: 'dir rtsa ba'i sa bcad med kyang thog mar skyabs sems ni/ spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dang: skyabs gnas dkon mchog thams cad bsam: pha mas gtsor byas 'gro ba rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'gags rang gsal mchod pa 'bul: mu bzhir ltung ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes yi rang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: ka dag zang thal rjen par bzhugs: kun kyang rang rig rtogs par bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog: kye ma bdag gis 'gro kun bsgral bya'i phyir: rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ de nas bgegs gtor byin rlabs dang bsngo ba spyi ltar byas nas/ hūm̐: thams cad bde gshegs rgyal ba'i rang bzhin la:

nga bdag gzung 'dzin rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang: dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha la ma gtogs pa'i: log 'dren bar chod bgegs rnams phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga bān bid+yā rā tsa kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed dbang chen 'bar ba'i sku: log 'dren gdug pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun: gal te nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na: thal ba rdul bzhin lus sems brlag par 'gyur: oṃ shrī badz+ra h+ya grī ba ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa rak+ṣa uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gtum po ri rab rtse brgyad na: 'bar ba'i lha brgyad dbang chen ka steng du: shin tu mi bzad dbang chen gtso dang 'khor: rta skad thengs gsum gar dgu'i tshul gyis rol: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba dgra bgegs 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas drag po me'i mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams me yi rba klong 'khrugs: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal te: phrag dog nyon mongs lnga ni sreg byed na: ye shes lnga yi me ni phyogs bcur 'phro: phyogs mtshams me yi 'khor los gtams pa la: me yi mtshams las bgegs rnams ma 'da' zhig: raṃ dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa: trag raṃ kha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas skabs 'dir mchod pa byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: kun la 'gres so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ma dha la hūm̐ hrīḥthā: de nas dam bca' gzung ba bya ste: hūm̐: dbang drag dkyil 'khor bde gshegs lha yi tshogs:

ma bcos spros bral bde chen rang rig lha: ye nas rang byung rang rig rang gsal gdab: 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du bsgrub lags so: badz+ra sa mā ti hūm̐: de nas byin dbab pa ni: oṃ: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: thugs rje 'gag med dngos grub kun gyi gter: sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen dbab tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ā be sha ya hūm̐: bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong dgongs: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag sogs: rang sems gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags na: mnyam nyid klong yangs ngang du bzod par gsol: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: de yan chad rang byung sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o: de nas yul gzhan nas byung ba gnyis med du sgrub pa'i las khrigs nyer gsum las: dang po sa mā ti rnam pa gsum las: de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung rang gsal gting mtha' med pa'i klong: mi gnas mi dmigs spros pa med pa'i ngang: brjod med mnyam nyid rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: thams cad snying po byang chub sems kyi ngang: ma rtogs rang byung rang gsal thabs kyi mchog: gnyis med don gyi rang bzhin rtogs bya'i phyir: 'gro kun snying rje'i ngang du rjes su bzung: bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: mi dmigs mtha' dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las: rang byung ye shes ma 'gags thugs rje'i rtsal: dmigs med ngang nas 'gro don rang byung rdzogs: rang byung rang gsal rgyu yi yi ge hrī: badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hrī: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul dag pa gsum:

me chu rlung gis bskal pa stongs: stong nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin las: gsang chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong nas: rgyu yi yi ge bdun du shar: e las nam mkha' chos 'byung dbyings: yaṃ las stobs chen rlung gi dal: ra las rgya mtsho gting mtha' med: suṃ las dbang chen gser gyi gzhi: keṃ las ri rab lhun chen brjid: raṃ las me phung srid rtser 'bar: hūm̐ e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: smug nag bh+rūm̐ las bskyed pa'i gzhal yas ni: dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus na gsal: 'gyur med chos dbyings zla gam e yi dbus: bhan+dha brtsegs ma gnam lcags gzer gyis bsdams: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi thod phreng 'bar bas bskor: phyi rim rtsibs brgyad khyams sgo rta babs rdzogs: lha brgyad ka ba gza' brgyad gdung ma bres: skar brgyad zhing thog nyi zla'i 'od skar mdzes: klu brgyad ka gdan sprul nag skyes bur btsug: zhing dang thod pa tsit+ta'i pho long mdzes: 'khor yug snam bu 'dod pa'i sprin phung gtibs: mnyam yang phyogs bral pho brang 'od du 'bar: rang snang ye shes las grub ngo mtshar che: dbang chen 'bar ba'i pho brang yongs rdzogs gsal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dzñā na tsakra ma dha la bh+rūm̐: ru tra kro ti ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya man dha la: a tsan+d+ra man dha la bh+rūm̐: de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: yi ge hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: dregs pa lha brgyad klu brgyad dang: bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: ma bcos rdzogs pa'i he ru ka: dbang chen zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor thabs bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog hrī: spyan dgu zhal bsgrad mche ba gtsigs: dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur gsum: rta skad phyogs bcur tse re re: phyag drug g.yas gsum gri gug dang: ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams:

g.yon gsum ban+dha dril bu dang: dbang gi lcags sgrog rgyu zhags 'dzin: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa lding: glang dang zhing gi g.yang gzhi gsol: rdo rje'i go khrab rab tu brjid: sbrul rigs lnga yis sku la brgyan: gdol pa nag po'i do shal la: mgo phreng lnga bcus rab tu spras: dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs can: thal chen zhag dang khrag gis brgyan: dpal gyi chas rnams yongs su rdzogs: mdun na rdo rje phag mo sbyor: sku mdog mthing nag rgyan drug mdzes: phyag g.yas gri gug yab la 'khyud: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang yab la 'khril: spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: rigs bzhi sras sogs lcam dral bskyed: bskal pa'i me phung klong na bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta pad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: phyogs bzhi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng: shar du rgyal rigs lhor rje rigs: nub tu dmangs rigs byang gdol ba: klu rigs bzhi yi gdan steng na: shar du sku yi rta mgrin dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang 'khril: rdo rje gri gug bhan+dha bsnams: lho ru yon tan rta mgrin ser: zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang 'khril: rin chen gri gug bhan+dha bsnams: nub tu gsung gi rta mgrin dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang 'khril: pad+ma gri gug bhan+dha bsnams: byang du phrin las rta mgrin ljang: zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang 'khril: rgya gram gri gug bhan+dha bsnams: yum rnams phyag g.yas gri gug 'khyud: g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob: thams cad gar dgu'i tshul du bzhugs: brkyang bskum gyad kyi 'dor thabs bgrad: de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad steng: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni: yab yum dkar po gri thod 'dzin: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ni: yab yum ser po gri thod 'dzin: nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ni: yab yum dmar po gri thod 'dzin:

byang du karma mkha' 'gro ni: yab yum ljang nag gri thod 'dzin: byang shar rdo rje shugs 'gro ni: yab yum phyed zhal gri thod 'dzin: shar lhor rin chen shugs 'gro ni: yab yum phyed zhal gri thod 'dzin: lho nub pad+ma shugs 'gro ni: yab yum phyed zhal gri thod 'dzin: nub byang karma shugs 'gro ni: yab yum phyed zhal gri thod 'dzin: kun kyang sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs: rgyan drug dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol: de yi phyi rim bar khyams la: sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: las byed lcam dral la sogs pa: gtso dang 'khor du yongs rdzogs bskyed: kun kyang spyi gtsug ljang zhur ni: rta skad phyogs bcur gtser zhing 'tsher: sgo bzhir rang byung khro rgyal bzhi: shar du badz+ra he ru ka: rdo rje lcags kyu bhan+dha bsnams: lho ru rat+na he ru ka: rin chen zhags pa bhan+dha bsnams: nub tu pad+ma he ru ka: pad+ma lcags sgrog bhan+dha bsnams: byang du karma he ru ka: rgya gram dril bu bhan+dha bsnams: kun kyang rab 'jigs rngams pa'i tshul: gsal stong nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar bsgom: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa e ka tsa ti trag rak+sha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: rol mo'i sgras byin dbab cing spyan drangs te: hūm̐ hrī: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bde chen dbang drag rol pa yi: bskal pa'i me rlung 'bar klong nas: dbang gi rgyal po gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing: me phung 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: dngos grub myur du stsol ba'i lha: rta skad 'tsher zhing gshegs su gsol: dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: dbang gi lha tshogs ma lus rnams: bar chad sel phyir gshegs su gsol: dbang chen rigs bzhi yum dang bcas: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: mkha' 'gro ging dang shugs 'gro bcas: phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol:

sprul pa las byed bye ba 'bum: gar dgu'i stabs kyis gshegs su gsol: shar lho nub byang phyogs mtshams nas: rigs bzhi'i sgo ba gshegs su gsol: sngon gyi thugs dam chen po yis: srid pa rdo rje dbang gi lha: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: dbang chen 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang: gdug pa ma lus 'joms pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: h+ya grī wa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pad+ma a bhā mu kha yo gī shwa rī h+ya grī wa he he hi hi hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: spros med bde chen gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: bdag dang gnyis med ngang du bsgrub slad du: dregs pa 'joms shing srin po 'dul ba'i lha: dbang gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: rngam brjid 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: h+ya grī wa badz+ra bā ra hī pra be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen kun 'dus rta mgrin dbang gi lha: gsang ba'i yum mchog e ka phag mo'i sku: rta gdong dbang drag 'khor dang bcas pa la: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: a la la ho: de nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa las: dang po phyi mchod ni: hūm̐: dbang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan mchod pa'i sprin: snang srid mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs brjod: nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tshogs la: dbang po lnga yi me tog dang: gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar me dang: rdo rje dri chu byug pas mchod: rdo rje dri chen zhal zas dang: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod:

ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: gsang ba'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: yab yum thabs shes sbyor ba las: bde chen byang chub sems kyi chu: smrar med bde ba'i gsang mchod kyis: dbang chen lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā pū dza pañtsa sa ma ye pū dza ho: de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: thams cad mnyam rdzogs byang chub sems: snang stong dran rtog ye shes lha: thams cad kun bzang khyab brdal ngang: dmigs med ngang du mchod pa bzhes: sa mā ti a bhe sha ya pū tsa ho: de nas sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: dug lnga gnas 'gyur ye shes sgrub pa'i rdzas: ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pa 'di: gsol zhing mchod do 'gro ba'i don du bzhes: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: snang ba mtha' yas 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon// pad+ma thod phreng mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma// dkon mchog 'byung gnas rat+na gling pa la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ tshe dbang grags pa ngag dbang grags pa'i dpal// shākya bkra shis pad+ma dbang phyug dang// bkra shis dbang phyug pad+ma dbang drag la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ karma chags med kun bzang shes rabs zhabs// lhun grub rgya mtsho pad+ma nor bu dang*// karma chos dpal karma lha dbang la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ karma 'gyur med gsang sngags bstan 'dzin sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' gter srung ma la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā:

zhes lha tshogs gzhan rnams la mtshan don sbyar ro// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas gsang ba'i gtor chen po: snang srid gzhir bzhengs 'dod yon ro mchog spungs: sha khrag dmar dang zhag gi sprin du gtibs: dbang chen lha tshogs zhal du rol cing bzhes: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dug gsum rtsad gcod dgra bgegs sgrol: 'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs bhan+dhar bskyil: dug lnga gnas su gzhom pa'i phyir: dbang gi lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: ma hā rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: de nas sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: yab yum thabs shes sbyor ba las: rdo rje pad+ma'i 'du byed kyis: nyon mongs 'dod chags thal bar brlag: sbyor ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: sarba pañtsa bo dhi tsit+ta gha na pū tsa khā hi: bsgral mchod bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen nga rgyal gyis: nyams pa'i ru dra 'gug cing bsgral: khro tshogs 'bar ba'i zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: ma traṃ ru dra pra bhan tsakra khā hi: skabs 'dir dbang gi rta bro glu mchod bya ste: mched rnams lu gu rgyud du sbrel: hūm̐: glu drug tshangs pa'i dbyings su sbyor: khro bo'i glu ni bdud bzhi 'dul: zhi ba'i glu drug dbyings su gsal: lta ba'i glu drug mtha' dang bral: dbu ma'i glu ni dgongs rgyud gsal: gdung ba'i glu ni ma sring bsten: las kyi glu ni pho nyar 'gyed: oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na pū dza ho: bro yi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: khro bo'i bro brdung dregs pa 'joms: dpal gyi bro brdung bdud bzhi 'dul: dbang gi bro brdung srin po 'dul: las kyi bro brdung pho nyar 'gyed: rnal 'byor bro brdung thams cad bskul: te te hūm̐ te na hūm̐: hūm̐: 'di ni dpal gyi thugs dam yin: 'di ni yum gyi gsung tshig yin: 'di ni ma sring dngos grub sdud:

'di ni dpal gyi pho nya yin: 'di ni rnal 'byor lta ba'i bro: dgra bgegs bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i bro: de phyir glu bro rgyun mi chad: a la la ho sa ma ya pū tsa ho: de nas dbang chen gtso 'khor la bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos nyid rnam dag spros dang bral ba las: thugs rje rol pa gzugs kyi skur ston pa: 'dod chags gsung gi pad+ma he ru ka: rngam brjid 'jigs pa'i sku mchog khyad par can: dur khrod chen po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: bskal pa'i me chen dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong: klu brgyad bdud bzhi nyi zla'i gdan steng na: gsung gi bdag nyid dbang chen pad+ma'i sku: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs bgrad: g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad par bstan pa ni: chos kyi sku la nyes pa'i skyon dang bral: zhal g.yon sngo la dwangs par bstan pa ni: thugs rje'i sprul pa sems can don la chags: dbus zhal dmar la rngam par bstan pa ni: rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i rtags: spyan dgu sdang mig dmar po bgrad pa ni: theg pa dgu yis 'gro ba'i don mdzad rtags: snyan drug 'gro ba'i rang sgra dbyings su gnas: shangs gsum ting 'dzin don la mnga' brnyes shing: ljags gsum theg pa gsum gyi chos sgra sgrog: ye shes mche bas skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: dbu skra kham ser srid gsum gyen du 'khyil: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan mig glog ltar 'gyu: sma ra ag tshom bskal pa'i me ltar 'khyil: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen 'brug stong ldir: ye shes lnga ldan dbu la rigs lngas brgyan: phyag mtshan drug ni pha rol phyin drug rdzogs: gri gug 'bar bas skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: gnam lcags ral gris 'khor ba rab tu gtubs: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: thugs rjes chags pa'i thod khrag zhal du gsol: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med dril bu 'khrol: dbang gi lcags sgrog rgyu zhags 'khor ba 'dren: zhabs bzhi phrin las rnam bzhis bdud bzhi 'joms:

dregs pa klu chen rtag chad mtha' gnyis grol: glang chen ko rlon stobs bcu lhun gyis rdzogs: zhing gi g.yang gzhi dpa' gtum stag sham brgyan: sbrul chun mgo phreng dug gsum 'khor ba 'dren: rdo rje rin chen gshogs pa thabs shes tshul: rta mgo ljang zhur srid gsum dbang du sdud: rdo rje'i go khrab dus gsum 'gyur ba med: rak+ta'i thig le thugs rje chags pa'i rtags: zhag gi zo ris don dam bcud mtshon zhing: thal chen tshom bu 'dul byed phrin las bdag: rab mdzes rgyan gyis bklubs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med gsang ba'i yum: rdo rje phag mo 'jigs byed dpal 'bar ma: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis te: chags pa'i mdangs ldan phyag g.yas gri gug 'khyud: phyag g.yon thod khrag gtso bo'i zhal du stob: bde ba'i gar stabs rol pa'i 'dzum mdangs can: phyag rgya lnga dang rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: dbu skra ser 'bol thur du 'phyang zhing grol: gzhon nu lang tsho mdzes pa'i mdangs ldan ma: gnyis med sku la 'khril nas mnyes mchod mdzad: 'dod chags khros pa'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku las sprul pa'i dbang chen rigs bzhi ni: zhal gcig phyag bzhi rigs kyi sku mdog mdzes: gri thod bsnams shing dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rigs dang mthun par rang rang yum dang 'khril: 'bar ba'i gar ldan rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las mkha' 'gro: dpa' bo ging dang thabs shes gnyis med sbyor: gri gug thod khrag bsnams shing rgyan rnams rdzogs: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs bzhi shugs 'gro yab yum gnyis med sbyor: rigs kyi phyed zhal dbu skra thor tshugs can: zhing gi g.yang gzhi rgyan drug dag gis spras: mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can la phyag 'tshal bstod: byi la pu shud las byed lcam dral bzhi:

dmar nag 'bar ba khrag gi ral pa gzings: mi sdug gzugs 'chang mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin: yang sprul pho nya las byed tshogs dang bcas: gtso bo'i bka' nyan phrin las thogs med sgrub: bstan pa srung mdzad tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: pho brang dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi na: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las ma lus mdzad: 'dzin 'ching sdom rdeg ye shes sgo ba'i tshul: sgo bzhi skyong mdzad khro rgyal chen po bzhi: gang 'dul phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod do: de nas dzap kyi dgongs pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rang byung ye shes dbang gi lha: mkha' 'gro ging dang rig 'dzin bcas: lhun grub longs sku'i dkyil 'khor nas: grags stong gsung gi sngags sgra sgrogs: spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes: bsdus pas dngos grub bdag la thim: gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ni: ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar: nam yang gtang ba'i dus med do: zhes dzap kyi dgongs pas gsal gdab cing dam bca' ste: dzap srin po'i ngur dbyangs ltar bzla'o: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdza: zhes grangs rtags la sbyar ro: skabs su stong tshigs kyis mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: dgongs shig bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha: ma lus thams cad dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan sgrub pa po: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blang: de nas rjes kyi las 'grigs lnga las: dang po tshogs mchod bya ba ni:

tshogs rgyas par bshams la: bdud rtsis bsang: swa bhā ba 'i sngags brjod nas: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis: chos rnams sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: dngos dang dngos 'dzin bag chags kun: yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis: bsregs shing bkrus te gtor bar bya: dag par ma gyur gang yang med: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ swā hā: gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥho: ye shes rnam lnga'i rang bzhin las: zhal zas dngos po yi ge lnga: yi ge sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang 'od du ltems kyis zhu: 'od phung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ces byin gyis brlab bo: de nas tshogs dang po 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: rta mgrin lha tshogs gtso dang 'khor: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: bar pa bskang ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam dbang chen tshogs: bdag cag lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bag med nyams chag 'khrul pa rnams: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: a hoḥm hā su kha sa ma ya ho: zhes bskang zhing bshags so: tha ma bsgral mchod bya ba ni: dgra bgegs kyi rū pa bya ste: a mu ka nṛ tri hriṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: zhes bkug cing bstim par bya: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas bdag nyid kyi stod rta mgrin gzhung bzhin la smad phur pa'i dbal mgar gyi sol me nas phyung pa ltar bskyed la: hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin yab yum ste: stod ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur pa 'dril: smad ni lcags phur tshwa tshwa 'phro: nam mkha'i mthong nas 'dril zhing 'debs: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: gnod byed dgra bgegs smos ci dgos: rgya mdud steng nas 'brug stong ldir:

changs bzung mtshams nas glog dmar 'khyug: chu srin kha nas tshwa tshwa 'phro: gzir ba tsam gyis rdul du brlag: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: a mu ka: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ces bsgral la: zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: phyes shig phyes shig zhal phyes shig: dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams: mkha' 'gro ging dang shugs 'gror bcas: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag 'di: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du sgrims shig ā ral+li: bzhes shig lhag ma med par rol: ces 'bul lo: de nas rdo rje slob dpon nas rim par drangs te: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos:= ces drang ngo: pad+ma'i phyag rgyas bskor zhing: ho: rin thang med las legs 'ong chos:= ces pas/ a la la ma hā su kha ho: de nas lhag mchod bshams te: dkyil 'khor shar lhor zhing gi gdan la lhag ma kha chus bran: dpal gtor nas kyu gu gcig kyang blangs nas lhag gtor du bzhag: bdud rtsi yang bran la: bh+yo: dbang gi bka' nyan lhag sdud ni: las kyi mkha' 'gro mi srun ma: shin tu rab 'jigs keng rus gzugs: yan lag rus pa'i 'khor los brgyan: snying khrag 'thung zhing rkan sgra rdeb: rkang mgyogs brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul can: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can: sha za mkha' 'gro yang sprul bcas: lhag sdud ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges te: rnam pa sna tshogs nges med can: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag rol: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces lhag ma btang ngo: de nas las la bskul ba ni: gtor mar phud dang rak+tas sbreng: sha chen gyi dud pa btang: rol mo'i sgra bsgrag ste: bh+yo: dur khrod rab 'jigs me phung klong: keng rus sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil: sha za gcan gzan mang po'i gnas: khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing: phyag na rdo rje skyi g.ya'i gnas:

de 'dra'i gnas mchog chen po nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso: bde gshegs dbang chen yab yum bzhugs: yab yum sku yi 'khor lo la: mkha' 'gro 'bum tsho nyi shu rdzogs: bskul lo gtso 'khor las la bskul: sha khrag dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bh+yo: gzhan yang ye shes snod bcud dang: phyi nang las la grub pa'i tshogs: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams nyul: sras dang phra men dbang phyug sogs: sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges te: gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag dang: rnge'u chung rdeg 'joms mtshon cha 'dzin: sku regs dril bu g.yer khas brgyan: dar dpyang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: dbu rgyan dar dpyang cod pan can: rlung gis skyod cing pu ru ru: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: mkha' la thogs med bun ne bun: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar byed khyugs se khyug: phrin las gcig tu ma nges te: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med bsgrub: sha khrag dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces drag tu bskul na phrin las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: nub phyogs bde chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bcom ldan dbang chen pad+ma he ru kas: rta skad thengs gsum snang srid ma mo dbang du bsdus: tha tshig gsum gyis dam la btags pa'i tshe: rdo rje phag mo la sogs mkha' 'gro bye ba brgyas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i pho brang du: dbang chen rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa yi:

'gro 'dul dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag nyi shu yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: de 'og bar gyi dus tshigs dbus ma la: dpal gyi bsam yas ar+ya pa gling du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang: slob ma'i dwangs ma rje 'bangs grogs lnga yis: dbang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i tha ma la: lho brag mkhar chu gnyan gyi dben gnas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: nam snying mtsho rgyal rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang: lang gro lo tsā shel dkar rdo rje 'tshos: pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bse lang mkha' 'gro bka' sdod sgrol ging bzhi: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang:

chos kyi bdag po rat+na gling pa yis: dbang chen zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang gi bka' nyan dam can thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

de nas zor du 'phang ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen 'bar ba'i sku: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi: lha klu phyogs skyong gzhi bdag rnams: thams cad rang rang sku zur cig: dbang chen mthu stobs 'dus pa yi: gtor zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'di: gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: ces sgra di ri ri zor las bya'o: de nas gtor ma dpags te brtan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan pa: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: pad+ma rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: las kyi rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: dbang chen yab yum bka' sdod tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad sum cu gnyis: ging dang laṅka dur khrod bdag: ma bdun sgo bzhi sring mo bzhi: 'bar brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshogs: dbang chen pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas de bzhin du: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor gzhong bdud rtsis bshal la mchod do: de nas rta bro bya zhing gtor gzhong kha sbubs la 'og tu liṅga bzhag la 'di skad do: hrī: dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: khro rgyal rta mgrin khros pa'i sku: gnyis med rdo rje phag mo yum: gri gug thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: rta mgo phag zhal sgra sgrog cing: sdug bsngal nad kyi tshom bu la: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: rta bro 'khor gcig dang po la: bdud bzhi 'joms pa chen po'i bro: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma:

zhing bcu'i tshogs la da rdungs shig: rta bro 'khor gnyis bar ma la: srin po sha za'i longs spyod bro: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'byung po'i tshogs la da rdungs shig: rta bro 'khor gsum tha ma la: khams gsum khrag 'thung nad kyi bro: gti mug 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: 'khor ba'i gcod nad skran la rdungs: rdul du rlogs shig dgra dang bgegs: rgya mtsho'i gting sba ri rab mnan: 'khor bskyon chu srin kha ru bor: oṃ āḥhūm̐ s+t+wam+bha ya nan: zhes lu gu rgyud sbrel te bro brdung ngo: skabs 'dir sa bcad kyis ma bsdus kyang spyi ltar rjes kyi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ha ya grī ba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ hrī: chos kyi sku la dbye bsal mi mnga' yang: gdul bya'i thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul slad du: gang 'dul sprul pa gtso dang 'khor du sprul: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na/ oṃ: 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya/ bdag bskyed hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis 'od gsal du bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis dkyil 'khor gsum du ldang*/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag gis dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub lta sgom spyod: sbyin sogs dge bcu ci spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur te: bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyis: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: ces bsngo smon bya/ de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: na mo: chos sku snang mtha' longs spyod dbang chen sku: sprul sku pad+ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dang: dbang chen pad+ma gar gyi lha tshogs rnams: phyi nang bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor bcas:

bde legs thams cad 'dus pa'i bkra shis shog: ces dang gzhan yang rgya cher brjod do: de nas lha gshegs dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing smon lam gdab: rang nyid nga rgyal brtan pos rgyun spyod bya'o: de nas nang du log la bshags pa bya: tshe 'gugs bkra shis pa'i glu bro la sogs pa bya'o: rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ gter gyi las byang gzhir bzhag nas/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub yang gsang khros pa la sogs pa rnams nas kha bskangs shing mang nyung ran la khyer bde ba 'di ni gter ston rat+na gling pas lug lo la nub g.yu mtsho'i mgul bde chen gling du sbyar ba'o// // yi ge pa ni khams pa'i bya bral byang chub blo gros kyis bgyis pa'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig// /ces pa'i las byang rat+na'i gsung bslad med la med ka med kyi kha skong gsal kha phran bu blo gros mtha' yas kyis zhus pa dge legs 'phel// //
